summary: Materialise NV (Nasdaq: MTLS) filed a Form 6-K to report weekly progress of its share buyback program announced on 30 October 2025. Under the program, up to EUR 30 million is authorized for share repurchases through a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary. In the week ending 10 July 2026, the company bought 26,064 shares at an average EUR 6.20 per share (total ~EUR 0.16M). Since program inception (26 January 2026), 1,106,406 shares (1.9% of outstanding) have been repurchased for EUR 5.4M. The program is executed on Nasdaq via open-market purchases, no block trades. Watch for continued weekly disclosures; risk-arb angle is minimal as this is an open-market buyback, not a tender offer.
